children: Lazard filed a prospectus supplement covering the possible resale of up to 9,416,817 shares issued in connection with its acquisition of Campbell Lutyens Holdings.
The shares were issued to selling stockholders in connection with Lazard’s acquisition of all outstanding ownership interests in Campbell Lutyens Holdings.
Lazard filed an opinion from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP regarding the validity of the securities as an exhibit to the filing.
